m: स—धातु See पद-सधातु.

a: सधर्मन् — a. 1 Having similar properties. --2 Having similar duties. --3 Of the same sect or caste. --4 Like, resembling. --Comp. --चारिणी a legal wife, a legally married wife.

m: स—धर्म—त्व n. the having a similar nature, homogeneousness, Suśr.; Pañcat.
स—धर्मिणी (इणी), f. a legal or virtuous wife, L.
